close_reason: Added #[non_exhaustive] above #[derive(...)] line, matching the canonical sibling pattern (BlobLookupEntry et al.). cargo test -p jmap-chat-client green, clippy clean, fmt clean. Committed as 67a30f1 (batched with sibling #[non_exhaustive] beads).
description:
File: crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/quota.rs:21-53.

`Quota` is a `pub struct` deserialized from the wire (`urn:ietf:params:jmap:quota`) but lacks `#[non_exhaustive]`. Other deserialized response structs in the crate consistently carry it. The struct already opts into the workspace extras-preservation policy with a `pub extra: serde_json::Map<...>` field — the `#[non_exhaustive]` attribute is the matching half of that policy (workspace AGENTS.md "Extras-preservation policy for vendor/site fields").

Caller impact: any future RFC clarification adding a typed field (e.g. a `period: String` or `hardLimit: bool`) becomes a major-version bump here. RFC 9425 is published but follow-on documents (jmap-quotas extensions, vendor extensions) routinely add fields.

Fix: add `#[non_exhaustive]` above the struct declaration.
title: Quota struct missing #[non_exhaustive]
